commentary.narrative_context: The Gauss-Bonnet theorem is a fundamental result in differential geometry that links the local Gaussian curvature of a surface to its global topological Euler characteristic. It is a constraint on the possible geometries of surfaces.

Mathematical Community: Institutional/Analytical - accepts and uses the theorem.
Analytical Observer: Analytical/Analytical - recognizes the theorem as a fundamental truth.
